question: Must even one who has completed prior rites perform expiation, O foremost twice-born?
premises: The addressees are the foremost twice-born.
The subject has already performed prior rites.
Expiation is especially required even in that case.
inference: Completion of prior rites does not remove the need for expiation.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, even one who has already performed the prior rites must especially undergo expiation.
